known_design_gaps.construction_hash_excludes_data_path: spec.py construction_hash() hashes only {market, feature.pipeline, target, universe} and deliberately excludes spec.data[].path. SF-0009 (hashrate) and SF-0010 (active_addresses) share the same hash despite different input series. This is a pre-existing design defect not introduced by lane E (spec.py is unchanged in this PR). Dedup key is too coarse; input-series-distinct constructions can be silently suppressed. Pre-registered for Fable/orchestrator adjudication on whether data[].path should be incorporated into the hash.
